longDescription: Seven workflows from one shared source for starting a project, checking progress, reviewing exposure and legal questions, preparing a release, drafting change notes and ending a chat deliberately. Choose Plain questions or Kitchen names; install one naming variant at a time. Local tools may be required. Scanners are optional; no hooks or MCP server are bundled. Reviews are not security or legal certification. Publication, deletion and external actions require separate authorization.
defaultPrompt: Help me plan a small portfolio website with three projects.
Evaluate this repository for release readiness without publishing.
Draft release notes from the actual diff between the supplied Git refs.
